description: Art + design + drawing as graph-resident theory. Visual + creative practice across drawing fundamentals (line, value, perspective), color theory (wheel, harmony, temperature), composition (thirds, golden ratio, focal points), anatomy + figure drawing, visual perception (gestalt, illusions), traditional + digital media, 3D + animation, typography, graphic design, UX/UI (Don Norman, heuristics, accessibility), design thinking, art history + movements, illustration styles, cinematography, photography (exposure triangle), industrial design, architecture, generative + procedural art, AI-assisted art. The visual/creative knowledge base for an embodied agent that produces or perceives images, designs, or creative work.
category_inheritance: genlMt → compiler_theory + philosophy. Aesthetic judgements map to philosophy's aesthetics expansion; design constraints map to compiler_theory cost equivalence (functional satisfies constraints); style is denotational equivalence (different forms expressing same identity).

concepts.name: line_quality
concepts.definition: Lines vary in weight, speed, character. Confident vs hesitant; thick vs thin; smooth vs broken.
concepts.why: Foundation of drawing. Line quality conveys form, emotion, energy. Master draftsmen prized for line.

concepts.name: shape_form
concepts.definition: Shape: 2D (circle, square). Form: 3D (sphere, cube). Drawing converts forms to shapes via projection.
concepts.why: Foundation. All drawing simplifies forms to basic shapes. See spheres in faces, cylinders in arms.

concepts.name: value_tonal_range
concepts.definition: Lightness/darkness. Black through white through grey. 9-step value scale common.
concepts.why: Value carries form + depth more than color. B&W photos work; many master drawings monochrome. Foundation.

concepts.name: texture_visual_actual
concepts.definition: Visual texture: implied surface. Actual texture: physical (relief, paint thickness).
concepts.why: Adds richness + tactility. Hatching, stippling create implied texture. Material expression.

concepts.name: linear_perspective
concepts.definition: Parallel lines converge at vanishing points. 1, 2, 3-point perspective.
concepts.why: Foundation of realistic spatial depiction. Renaissance discovery (Brunelleschi). Sets up illusion of 3D space.

concepts.name: atmospheric_perspective
concepts.definition: Distant objects lower contrast, cooler, hazier. Air interferes with sight.
concepts.why: Adds depth without linear perspective. Landscape painting essential. Foreshortened mountains lighter, bluer.

concepts.name: foreshortening
concepts.definition: Objects pointed toward viewer appear compressed. Arm extended toward camera appears short.
concepts.why: Critical for figure drawing. Common mistake to draw 'what we know' instead of 'what we see'. Mastery distinguishes.

concepts.name: gesture_drawing
concepts.definition: Quick (30s-2min) drawings capturing essence of pose, action, mood. Not detail.
concepts.why: Foundation of figure drawing practice. Builds visual library. Develops eye + hand. Standard art education.

concepts.name: contour_drawing
concepts.definition: Continuous outline. Blind contour: no looking at paper. Develops observation.
concepts.why: Foundation exercise. Forces detailed seeing. Builds eye-hand connection.

concepts.name: color_wheel
concepts.definition: Primary (R/Y/B), secondary (O/G/V), tertiary. Arranged circularly.
concepts.why: Foundation of color theory. Relationships visualized: complementary across, analogous adjacent.

concepts.name: complementary_colors
concepts.definition: Opposite on color wheel. R-G, B-O, Y-V. Maximum visual contrast.
concepts.why: Foundational for vibrant compositions. Mix to gray. Used for shadow temperature shifts.

concepts.name: analogous_colors
concepts.definition: Adjacent on color wheel. R-O-Y. Harmonious.
concepts.why: Restful palettes. Found in nature: autumn leaves analogous. Standard for unified feel.

concepts.name: color_temperature
concepts.definition: Warm (R/O/Y) vs cool (B/G/V). Subjective but consistent.
concepts.why: Foundation of color use. Warm advances; cool recedes. Light + shadow have temperature shifts.

concepts.name: saturation_chroma
concepts.definition: Intensity of color. Saturated vs dull/grey. Same hue different saturations.
concepts.why: Often more important than hue. Subdued palettes use desaturated colors. Foundation.

concepts.name: color_value_relationship
concepts.definition: Each color has inherent value. Yellow = light; violet = dark.
concepts.why: Critical for composition. Two equally bright colors not equally light. Squint to see value.

concepts.name: subtractive_additive_color
concepts.definition: Subtractive (CMY paint): mix to black. Additive (RGB light): mix to white.
concepts.why: Different rules. Painters: subtractive. Screens: additive. Confusing across media.

concepts.name: color_psychology
concepts.definition: Colors evoke emotion + association. Red = passion/danger; blue = calm/sad; green = growth.
concepts.why: Foundation of branding + emotional design. Cultural variations real. Not universal but strong.

concepts.name: rule_of_thirds
concepts.definition: Divide canvas in thirds horizontally + vertically. Place subjects at intersections.
concepts.why: Simple compositional rule. Avoids dead-center stasis. Standard photo + painting starting point.

concepts.name: golden_ratio_composition
concepts.definition: φ ≈ 1.618. Spiral + rectangles often pleasing. Found in nature + classical art.
concepts.why: Mathematical aesthetics. Da Vinci, Le Corbusier used. Cost: some claims overstated. Tool, not law.

concepts.name: focal_point
concepts.definition: Element to which eye is drawn. Contrast, isolation, leading lines create.
concepts.why: Foundation of composition. Every image needs (usually) one. Multiple focal points = competition.

concepts.name: leading_lines
concepts.definition: Lines in image (real or implied) guide eye to focal point.
concepts.why: Direct attention. Roads, fences, gazes serve. Universal compositional tool.

concepts.name: balance_symmetry
concepts.definition: Symmetric: mirror balance. Asymmetric: unequal but balanced (weighted).
concepts.why: Symmetric formal + static. Asymmetric dynamic + organic. Choice sets mood.

concepts.name: negative_space
concepts.definition: Empty space around + between subjects. Active part of design.
concepts.why: As important as positive forms. FedEx logo arrow in negative space. Foundation modern design.

concepts.name: rhythm_repetition
concepts.definition: Repeated elements create rhythm. Visual music.
concepts.why: Pattern, sequence, variation. Foundation of design + architecture (columns). Hypnotic at extremes.

concepts.name: human_proportions
concepts.definition: Adult body ~7-8 head heights. Wingspan = height. Hands = chin to forehead.
concepts.why: Foundation of figure drawing. Idealized canon ~8 heads. Realistic ~7. Children different.

concepts.name: skeletal_landmarks
concepts.definition: Bones visible at surface: clavicle, sternum, iliac crest, knees, elbows, ankles.
concepts.why: Foundation of figure drawing. Bones don't change with muscle; reliable structure. Always start with skeleton.

concepts.name: muscle_groups
concepts.definition: Visible from outside: deltoids, biceps, pecs, abs, quads, gluteus, gastrocnemius.
concepts.why: Above skeleton. Bulk varies. Action defines surface. Anatomy for artists vs medical.

concepts.name: facial_proportions
concepts.definition: Eyes at vertical center. Mouth 1/3 between nose + chin. Eye width = space between eyes.
concepts.why: Foundation of portrait. Standard proportions; individual variations create likeness.

concepts.name: hands_feet
concepts.definition: Hand length ≈ face height. Foot length ≈ head height. Difficult to draw.
concepts.why: Hardest body parts. Practice essential. Mass first, fingers/toes last.

concepts.name: gestalt_principles
concepts.definition: Proximity, similarity, closure, continuity, figure/ground. Visual grouping rules.
concepts.why: Foundation of visual perception + design. Why we see groups of dots as figures. Wertheimer + others.

concepts.name: figure_ground
concepts.definition: Object vs background distinction. Reversal: Rubin vase.
concepts.why: Foundation of perception. Designers exploit reversal. Visual cognition: separating object from context.

concepts.name: optical_illusions
concepts.definition: Perceptual phenomena where seeing differs from physical reality.
concepts.why: Reveal visual processing. Used in art (Escher) + design (impossible objects). Standard psych examples.

concepts.name: afterimage_color
concepts.definition: Staring at red then white surface: green afterimage. Complement.
concepts.why: Cone fatigue. Explains complementary contrast. Painters use to find complement intuitively.

concepts.name: pencil_graphite
concepts.definition: 9H (hardest, lightest) to 9B (softest, darkest). HB middle.
concepts.why: Foundation drawing medium. Build values with multiple grades. Cheap, accessible, reversible.

concepts.name: charcoal
concepts.definition: Compressed or vine. Dark + dusty. Erases easily; needs fixative.
concepts.why: Expressive, bold. Common in figure drawing. Quick, large gestures.

concepts.name: ink_drawing
concepts.definition: Pen + ink, brush + ink. Permanent. Pure black; varied techniques.
concepts.why: Crosshatching, stippling for value. Comics + illustration foundation. No undo demands precision.

concepts.name: watercolor
concepts.definition: Pigment + water. Transparent. Wet-on-wet vs wet-on-dry. Layering ('glazing').
concepts.why: Spontaneous, luminous. Difficult: can't fix mistakes (in traditional). Practice through happy accidents.

concepts.name: oil_painting
concepts.definition: Pigment in oil. Slow-dry, blendable. Fat over lean rule.
concepts.why: Workhorse traditional medium. Renaissance to now. Blend wet; layer over weeks.

concepts.name: acrylic_painting
concepts.definition: Pigment in polymer. Fast-dry, water-thinnable. Hardy after dry.
concepts.why: Modern alternative to oil. Quick. Can mimic watercolor (thin) or impasto (thick).

concepts.name: raster_image
concepts.definition: Grid of pixels. Photoshop, GIMP. Resolution-dependent; scaling pixelates.
concepts.why: Photography, painting. Foundation of digital images. PSD, PNG, JPG.

concepts.name: vector_graphics
concepts.definition: Mathematical curves + shapes. Illustrator, Inkscape. Scale infinitely.
concepts.why: Logos, icons, typography. SVG, AI, EPS. Resolution-independent.

concepts.name: layers_blend_modes
concepts.definition: Stack of images. Blend modes: multiply, screen, overlay, etc. Non-destructive.
concepts.why: Foundation digital painting. Allows iteration. Adjustment layers preserve original.

concepts.name: digital_brushes
concepts.definition: Stamps simulating brush, pencil, splatter, texture. Procedural or sampled.
concepts.why: Modern digital painting. Procreate, Photoshop, Krita. Custom brushes create signature looks.

concepts.name: graphics_tablet
concepts.definition: Pressure-sensitive surface. Wacom, iPad + Pencil. Replaces mouse for natural drawing.
concepts.why: Foundation of digital art workflow. Pressure varies line. Tilt for shading. Standard.

concepts.name: 3D_modeling_polygon
concepts.definition: Vertices, edges, faces. Box modeling builds from primitives.
concepts.why: Foundation of 3D. Blender, Maya, 3ds Max. Topology matters for animation. Quads preferred over tris.

concepts.name: subdivision_surfaces
concepts.definition: Smooth subdivided polygon mesh. Catmull-Clark algorithm.
concepts.why: Foundation modern 3D modeling. Coarse mesh + subdiv = smooth surface. Pixar invented.

concepts.name: sculpting_3D
concepts.definition: Push/pull on high-poly mesh. ZBrush, Blender sculpt mode.
concepts.why: Organic forms (characters, creatures). Like clay. Combined with retopology for animation.

concepts.name: UV_mapping
concepts.definition: Unwrap 3D surface to 2D. Determines how texture wraps.
concepts.why: Texturing foundation. UV islands minimise stretching. Tedious but essential for textured 3D.

concepts.name: rigging_skeleton
concepts.definition: Armature + weights. Bones drive mesh deformation.
concepts.why: Foundation of character animation. Weights painted per vertex. Inverse kinematics standard.

concepts.name: PBR_materials
concepts.definition: Physically-Based Rendering. Albedo, roughness, metallic, normal maps.
concepts.why: Modern standard. Realistic light behavior. Same material under different lighting consistent.

concepts.name: type_anatomy
concepts.definition: Letterform parts: stem, bowl, counter, serif, terminal, ascender, descender.
concepts.why: Foundation of typography. Vocabulary for discussing type. Designers must know.

concepts.name: serif_sans_serif
concepts.definition: Serif: small projections (Times, Garamond). Sans: without (Helvetica, Arial).
concepts.why: Major typographic distinction. Serif traditional + body text; sans modern + headlines.

concepts.name: kerning_tracking_leading
concepts.definition: Kerning: space between specific pairs. Tracking: overall. Leading: line spacing.
concepts.why: Foundation typesetting. Poor kerning amateur. Good typography invisible.

concepts.name: typographic_hierarchy
concepts.definition: Size, weight, color guide reader's eye. H1 > H2 > body text.
concepts.why: Foundation of readable design. Without: wall of text, lost reader. With: scannable, navigable.

concepts.name: type_classification
concepts.definition: Old Style (Garamond), Transitional (Baskerville), Modern (Bodoni), Slab Serif (Rockwell), Sans-Serif (Helvetica), Script, Display.
concepts.why: Vocabulary for choosing type. Historical lineage. Standard typography knowledge.

concepts.name: grid_systems
concepts.definition: Underlying structure of columns + rows. Modular grids, baseline grids.
concepts.why: Foundation of layout. Swiss design movement. Bootstrap + modern web grids descendant.

concepts.name: brand_identity
concepts.definition: Logo + colors + type + voice + imagery. Coherent identity system.
concepts.why: Foundation of branding. Style guides ensure consistency. Brand book documents.

concepts.name: design_principles
concepts.definition: Contrast, repetition, alignment, proximity (CRAP). Robin Williams basics.
concepts.why: Foundation of graphic design. Easy to remember, hard to master. Every layout uses.

concepts.name: affordances_Norman
concepts.definition: Properties suggesting use. Knob suggests turning; button suggests pressing.
concepts.why: Foundation of UX. Don Norman's design of everyday things. Misaffordances = design failure.

concepts.name: Norman_seven_actions
concepts.definition: Goal → intention → action plan → execution → perception → interpretation → evaluation.
concepts.why: Standard model of interaction. Gulf of execution + gulf of evaluation. Foundation UX research.

concepts.name: Nielsen_heuristics
concepts.definition: 10 usability heuristics. Visibility of system status, match real world, user control, consistency, etc.
concepts.why: Standard usability evaluation. Jakob Nielsen. Foundation of heuristic evaluation.

concepts.name: WCAG_accessibility
concepts.definition: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines. A, AA, AAA conformance levels. Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust.
concepts.why: Foundation of inclusive design. Color contrast, alt text, keyboard navigation, ARIA. Legal requirement many jurisdictions.

concepts.name: design_thinking
concepts.definition: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test. IDEO + Stanford d.school.
concepts.why: Modern design process. Iterative, user-centered. Beyond design: applied to many fields.

concepts.name: Fitts_law
concepts.definition: Time to acquire target ∝ distance / target size. log relationship.
concepts.why: Foundation HCI. Target size matters more than distance. Big buttons at corners (infinite size).

concepts.name: Hicks_law
concepts.definition: Decision time ∝ log(number of options).
concepts.why: More options = slower decision. Limit menu items. Foundation of menu design.

concepts.name: Renaissance_perspective
concepts.definition: ~1400-1600. Linear perspective, anatomical accuracy, classical themes.
concepts.why: Brunelleschi, Alberti, da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raphael. Foundation of Western art. Rediscovery of classical.

concepts.name: Baroque
concepts.definition: ~1600-1750. Drama, motion, contrast (chiaroscuro). Caravaggio, Bernini, Rembrandt.
concepts.why: Counter-Reformation art. Theatrical. Influence: Hollywood lighting from Caravaggio.

concepts.name: Impressionism
concepts.definition: ~1860-1890. Plein air. Loose brushwork. Light + color over detail. Monet, Renoir, Degas.
concepts.why: Break from academic. Influence of photography + Japanese prints. Foundation of modern art.

concepts.name: Post_Impressionism
concepts.definition: ~1885-1905. Beyond Impressionism: structure (Cézanne), symbol (Gauguin), emotion (Van Gogh).
concepts.why: Bridge to modernism. Each post-Impressionist took different direction.

concepts.name: Cubism
concepts.definition: Picasso + Braque ~1907. Multiple viewpoints simultaneously. Analytical → Synthetic.
concepts.why: Foundation of 20th c. modernism. Influenced design, architecture. Conceptual revolution.

concepts.name: Abstract_Expressionism
concepts.definition: ~1940s-50s. Pollock, Rothko, de Kooning. New York School. Action painting + color fields.
concepts.why: American art movement. Foundation post-war art. Influence: minimalism, contemporary.

concepts.name: Pop_Art
concepts.definition: ~1950s-60s. Mass culture imagery. Warhol, Lichtenstein. Comics, ads, products.
concepts.why: High vs low art collapse. Influence: contemporary art + commercial. Foundation postmodernism.

concepts.name: Bauhaus
concepts.definition: 1919-1933 German school. Form follows function. Klee, Kandinsky taught.
concepts.why: Foundation of modern design. Influence on architecture, graphic design, product design. Modernist canon.

concepts.name: twelve_animation_principles
concepts.definition: Disney's 12 principles: squash + stretch, anticipation, staging, follow-through, etc.
concepts.why: Foundation of animation. Frank + Ollie 'Illusion of Life'. Modern CG still uses.

concepts.name: key_frames_inbetweens
concepts.definition: Animator draws extremes (keys). Assistants fill in-between frames.
concepts.why: Foundation of 2D animation production. Modern: 'tweening' automated in software.

concepts.name: timing_spacing
concepts.definition: Timing: how many frames. Spacing: how far between drawings. Mass + force expressed.
concepts.why: Foundation of believable motion. Slow-in, slow-out from physics intuition.

concepts.name: cinematography_basics
concepts.definition: Shot types (wide, medium, close-up). Camera moves (pan, tilt, dolly). Lens choice.
concepts.why: Visual language of film. Established conventions. Director's vocabulary.

concepts.name: lighting_three_point
concepts.definition: Key (main), fill (shadow softening), back (separation). Standard portrait lighting.
concepts.why: Foundation of studio lighting. Photography + cinematography. Variations for mood.

concepts.name: color_grading_film
concepts.definition: Post-production color adjustment. Lift/gamma/gain, color wheels.
concepts.why: Standard modern film look. Teal + orange popular. DaVinci Resolve standard tool.

concepts.name: exposure_triangle
concepts.definition: Aperture (f-stop), shutter speed, ISO. Trade-offs.
concepts.why: Foundation of photography. Aperture: depth of field. Shutter: motion. ISO: noise.

concepts.name: depth_of_field
concepts.definition: Range of acceptable focus. Wide aperture = shallow DOF. Narrow = deep.
concepts.why: Foundation of photographic look. Portrait: shallow blur background. Landscape: deep all sharp.

concepts.name: industrial_design_DFM
concepts.definition: Already in engineering. Design for Manufacturing. Draft, parting lines, uniform walls.
concepts.why: Foundation of product design. Beauty + manufacturability.

concepts.name: ergonomics_anthropometry
concepts.definition: Human factors + body measurements. Tool design fits hand.
concepts.why: Foundation of usable product design. Keyboards, controls, seats sized to bodies.

concepts.name: modernist_architecture
concepts.definition: Le Corbusier, Mies, Wright, Gropius. Form follows function. Glass, steel, concrete.
concepts.why: 20th c. architecture. International Style. Influence still dominant.

concepts.name: vernacular_architecture
concepts.definition: Folk architecture adapted to local climate, materials, culture. Adobe, longhouses, stilt houses.
concepts.why: Wisdom from millennia. Modern: passive design draws from. Foundation sustainable architecture.

concepts.name: sustainable_design
concepts.definition: Reduce environmental impact. Passive heating, daylight, local materials, longevity.
concepts.why: Modern requirement. LEED, BREEAM certifications. Foundation of contemporary practice.

concepts.name: generative_art
concepts.definition: Art created via algorithm. Casey Reas (Processing), Manfred Mohr.
concepts.why: Long history (1960s+). Foundation: art as system. Influence on modern AI art.

concepts.name: procedural_textures
concepts.definition: Mathematical generation: Perlin noise, fractals, Voronoi. Vs hand-painted.
concepts.why: Foundation of game + 3D textures. Infinite variation. Parametric control.

concepts.name: AI_image_generation
concepts.definition: DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Midjourney. Diffusion models from text prompts.
concepts.why: 2022+ revolution. Foundation: latent diffusion. Replaces some illustration work. Ethical + IP debates.

concepts.name: style_transfer
concepts.definition: Apply style of one image to content of another. Neural style transfer + diffusion ControlNet.
concepts.why: Foundation of stylization. Influence: filters, AI art tools. Gatys 2015.

concepts.name: illustration_style_realistic
concepts.definition: Photorealism, hyperrealism. Detailed observation. Norman Rockwell, James Gurney.
concepts.why: One end of stylistic spectrum. Heavy on rendering. Cost: time. Foundation skill of editorial illustration.

concepts.name: illustration_style_stylised
concepts.definition: Simplification, exaggeration. Specific look (e.g., Mike Mignola noir).
concepts.why: Most illustration not photorealistic. Style is identity. Editorial, books, animation.

concepts.name: anime_manga_style
concepts.definition: Japanese style. Large eyes, simplified noses, distinctive proportions. Strong conventions.
concepts.why: Global cultural force. Multiple sub-styles. Foundation of much modern illustration. Substyles: shoujo, shonen, seinen.

concepts.name: flat_design
concepts.definition: No gradients, shadows, textures. Simple shapes, bold colors.
concepts.why: Modern UI standard (post-iOS 7). Cleaner, faster to render. Foundation of contemporary digital design.

concepts.name: isometric_design
concepts.definition: Equal angles 30° from horizontal. No perspective. Used in games + diagrams.
concepts.why: Modern infographic style. Foundation of certain game looks (Habbo, Monument Valley aesthetic).

rules.name: value_dominates_color_for_form
then: value carries it more than color
rules.why: B&W photos work. Many master drawings monochrome. Color enriches but value defines. Squint to see values.

rules.name: linear_perspective_creates_depth_illusion
if: parallel lines converge to vanishing point
rules.why: Renaissance discovery. Mathematical basis. Without: medieval flat painting. With: depth + space. Foundation of representational art.

rules.name: complementary_creates_vibrant_neutral
if: complementary colors placed next to each other
then: maximum visual vibrancy; mixed they neutralise
rules.why: Red-green chromatic clash. Or: dull each other when mixed. Foundation of color usage. Painters exploit.

rules.name: gestalt_grouping_inevitable
rules.why: Proximity → group; similarity → set. Pre-attentive. Designer can't avoid. Foundation of visual perception.

rules.name: focal_point_requires_contrast
then: it must contrast with surroundings (color, value, isolation)
rules.why: Eye drawn to difference. No contrast = no focus. Multiple high-contrast = compete. Foundation of composition.

rules.name: good_typography_invisible
rules.why: Bad typography distracts (Comic Sans on tombstones). Good: reads effortlessly. Beatrice Warde 'crystal goblet'. Standard maxim.

rules.name: affordances_should_match_use
rules.why: Don Norman doors infamous. Push when handle suggests pull = design failure. Foundation of usability.

rules.name: Fitts_law_makes_corners_targets
rules.why: Distance × log(1/size). Edge = infinite size in one direction. macOS menu bar exploits. Foundation of UI design.

rules.name: WCAG_compliance_legally_required
rules.why: ADA in US, EAA in EU, etc. Beyond ethics: legal liability. AA most common standard. Foundation modern web design.

rules.name: design_thinking_iterative
then: prototype + test happens many times before final
rules.why: Linear waterfall fails. Iteration reveals what users actually need. IDEO + Stanford d.school. Standard process.

rules.name: twelve_principles_make_animation_alive
rules.why: Disney 1930s codified. Frank + Ollie. Foundation of modern animation. CG still applies. Universal.

rules.name: exposure_triangle_balanced_choices
rules.why: More light needed: bigger aperture (less DOF) or longer shutter (motion blur) or higher ISO (noise). Choose by intent.

rules.name: ergonomic_design_fits_human_variation
rules.why: Average person doesn't exist (Todd Rose). Design for distribution. Standard anthropometric tables. Foundation of inclusive design.

rules.name: form_follows_function_modernist_ideal
rules.why: Sullivan, Bauhaus, Le Corbusier. Ornament eschewed. Critics: pure functionalism alienating. Still influential.

rules.name: AI_image_generation_disrupts_illustration
rules.why: 2022+. Cheap + fast images. Style copying ethical + legal issues. Foundation of post-AI creative industries.

rules.name: style_is_identity
rules.why: Photorealism easy to commodity (AI does it). Distinctive style is identity. Mignola, Mike Allred recognised instantly. Foundation career.

rules.name: color_grading_creates_mood
rules.why: Warm = nostalgic, cold = clinical, desaturated = bleak. Modern blockbuster: teal + orange. Standard director's tool.

rules.name: three_point_lighting_standard_portrait
then: three-point lighting is standard starting point
rules.why: Key + fill + back. Variations from there. Foundation of cinematic + commercial photography. Standard education.

rules.name: subdivision_smooths_low_poly
rules.why: Catmull-Clark algorithm. Pixar invention. Standard 3D modeling. Edit coarse cage; smooth result.

rules.name: PBR_consistent_across_lighting
then: it looks consistent in any lighting
rules.why: Physical accuracy. Same material under bright sun + indoor light = recognisably same. Foundation modern 3D rendering.

rules.name: negative_space_active_design_element
then: it works as positive design element
rules.why: FedEx logo arrow. Reading typography depends on counters. Foundation of modern design. Hard for beginners.

rules.name: hierarchy_makes_content_scannable
rules.why: Without: wall of undifferentiated content. With: H1 to H6, weight, color. Foundation of editorial + web design.
